reported_fitted_or_used.name: 300 W DC spindle
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: The build page lists an xPro v2 controller, NEMA 23 motors and a 300 W DC spindle. Acrylic mounts carry the controller board, fan and two power supplies, with an aluminum extrusion frame supporting the electronics assembly. The owner described barrel jacks as connectors: two jacks per motor, one per sensor, and additional connections for fan power, Z touch plate and spindle control. This is a connector-count/function description only; the page does not state jack polarity, contact order, controller terminal assignments, or a complete electrical pinout.
